workflow.name: Film Crew workflow
workflow.description: Storyboard → Producer → Screenwriter → Director → Editor pipeline with offload, conditionals, HITL, and verification. Validates the Guaardvark close-out bet.

tasks.description: Create storyboard frames from the goal. MUST use image_gen tool to generate at least one storyboard frame. Save frames to workspace.
Offload heavy render tasks. MUST use compute_delegate with task_type=image_gen and include producer payload. Verify offload status.
Research narrative and write screenplay beats. MUST use web_search tool to ground story research.
Animate storyboard into video. MUST use video_gen mode=image_to_video with a prompt describing the scene transition.
Stitch and verify the final cut. MUST use video_edit action=stitch then MUST use terminal to ls the artifacts directory. Verification will check output.mp4 exists.
conditions: 'APPROVED' in task_3 or 'completed' in task_3 or True
